project_info.title: MULTIVERSE PRO
project_info.tagline: Explore the lives you could have lived… for absolutely no reason.
project_info.theme: Dark Scientific Laboratory / Alternate Reality Quantum Computational Platform
project_info.vibe: Elegantly absurd, hyper-advanced, cinematic research laboratory software analyzing pointless human situations with maximum mathematical gravitas.

persona_and_concept.design_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation: High-density CERN/NASA quantum computing control center merged with editorial serif typography and satirical uselessness.
persona_and_concept.core_contrast_joke: SERIOUS QUANTUM COMPUTATIONAL UI + COMPLETELY TRIVIAL/USELESS PROBLEMS
persona_and_concept.visual_direction: Deep dark navy/void canvas with cyan, laser blue, and electric purple glowing nodes, glassmorphism panels, circular telemetry meters, data streams, and delicate 1px grid borders. Absolute avoidance of generic hacker/cyberpunk slop.

display_serif.usage: Main headlines, Multiverse titles, dramatic report callouts, universe designations, and section hero titles.

body_sans.usage: UI copy, narrative observations, description cards, modal text, form inputs.

data_monospace.usage: Subsystem codes, telemetry meters, timeline timestamps, universe statistics, reality integrity metrics, status indicators, and terminal logs.

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold text-white tracking-tight
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold text-cyan-100

layout_and_spacing.structure: Desktop Software Application feeling with sticky/fixed header bar, left/bottom interactive dock, and central flexible node graph / module viewport.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous interior padding (p-6 to p-8 on cards) with 12px-24px gap separation between dashboard widgets.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_glass: glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-cyan-500/20 rounded-xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]
layout_and_spacing.grid_borders: 1px grid lines with subtle corner crosshairs (+) to accentuate high-precision laboratory visual aesthetic.

multiverse_core.name: MULTIVERSE CORE
multiverse_core.role: Central processing hub showing interactive canvas node-graph connecting all 7 modules.

multiverse_engine.name: Multiverse Decision Engine
multiverse_engine.description: Processes trivial decisions (e.g. 'Should I eat leftover pizza?') to compute 3-5 alternate timelines with probabilities, butterfly effects, and universe numbers.

brain_weather.name: Brain Weather Diagnostic
brain_weather.description: Calculates mental atmospheric conditions (e.g. 'ACADEMIC THUNDERSTORM', 'PROCRASTINATION FOG') based on sleep, task overload, and phone checks.

room_amnesia.name: Room Amnesia Engine
room_amnesia.description: Simulates stepping into a room and instantly forgetting why. Calculates Purpose Detection, Memory Stability, and feeds Confusion directly into Brain Weather.

classroom_chaos.name: Classroom Chaos Matrix
classroom_chaos.description: Multi-select student dynamics to calculate live chaos, productivity loss, and teacher existential dread.

time_machine.name: Stupid Decision Time Machine
time_machine.description: Temporal scanning interface with countdowns allowing users to 'DO IT AGAIN', 'MAKE IT WORSE', or 'WARN PAST SELF (AND BE IGNORED)'.

conversation_replay.name: Conversation Replay & Overthinker
conversation_replay.description: Inputs past awkward dialogue, measures awkwardness score, clarity %, and offers an infinite [OVERTHINK AGAIN] simulation loop.

useless_statistics.name: Useless Statistics Engine
useless_statistics.description: Aggregates real-time ridiculously precise, zero-value data points calculated from all active user simulations.

final_report.name: Final Multiverse Dossier
final_report.description: Cinematic full-screen summary with dramatic calculation animation concluding with 'Calculating Usefulness... 0.00%' reveal.

audio_system.ambient_hum: Synthetic multi-oscillator low-frequency ambient drone synthesized via Web Audio API or audio generator.
audio_system.ui_beeps: Subtle high-frequency sine wave blips on button clicks, tab switches, and node interactions.
audio_system.toggle: Global mute/unmute audio controller present in top navigation bar with visual soundwave indicator.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement full single-page interactive application in React (JavaScript / JSX).
Ensure the Landing Screen features a staggered initialization boot log ('[ONLINE] Quantum Coherence Matrix... OK') with a glowing [ENTER MULTIVERSE] primary button.
In the Dashboard, render an interactive HTML5 Canvas or SVG node graph showing the MULTIVERSE CORE at center connected by pulsating particle lines to the 7 subsystem nodes.
State management: Maintain in-memory state connecting modules together (e.g., Room Amnesia confusion increases Brain Weather storm intensity and adds to Useless Statistics aggregate count).
Include live telemetry widgets with animated circular SVG meters and Recharts data streams for Reality Integrity and Nonsense Levels.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='enter-multiverse-button', data-testid='node-brain-weather', data-testid='decision-input').
All buttons must have distinct hover states with glow and clear contrast.
Do NOT make external AI API calls; use rich, witty client-side template generators with randomized scientific metrics and humorous observations.
Add a global sound engine using Web Audio API to provide subtle UI blips and ambient background hum without requiring external assets.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic centered white cards and standard blue buttons. Use deep navy canvas, glowing 1px border cards, cyan tracking lines, editorial serif headings, and monospace statistics.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_rule: Use generous interior padding (p-6 to p-8) and backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rule: Do not use Inter for main headings. Main headings must use 'Playfair Display' or 'Cormorant Garamond' editorial serifs with tight letter-spacing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility_and_contrast: Ensure all text on hover explicitly sets readable text color. Buttons must have crisp focus indicators.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testability: All buttons, inputs, tabs, node cards, and modal triggers MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
